lines.en: label beachwars5:
{i}You've received a new message from Ami Arakawa!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你收到了一条来自 Ami Arakawa 的新消息!{/i}

lines.en: scene noonsky
The dawning of a new day dies, but an ending has begun.
lines.zh: 新一天的黎明死去,而一个结局已然开始。

lines.en: And with the blue sky gone we’ll see another setting sun.
lines.zh: 蓝天既已消逝,我们便会看见又一轮落日。

lines.en: It’s orange and...all red or something. It’s glowing and it’s...fun?
lines.zh: 它是橙色的,还……通红什么的。它在发光,而且很……好玩?

lines.en: Words go here, then more words here. My stupid poem is done.
lines.zh: 词填这儿,然后再填更多词。我这首蠢诗就写完了。

lines.en: You know, I’ve got no idea how you do it. It’s easy enough to string together rhymes and whatnot, but putting them together in a way that actually makes sense is just way too difficult for me.
lines.zh: 你知道吗,我真不知道你是怎么做到的。把韵脚什么的串起来倒还算容易,可要把它们组合成真正说得通的样子,对我来说实在太难了。

lines.en: I’m sorry for not following in your footsteps but, in my defense, I can’t imagine you’d have much success when it comes to following {i}mine{/i} either.
lines.zh: 抱歉我没有追随你的脚步,不过说句公道话,我也不觉得你顺着{i}我的{/i}脚印走能有多大成就。

lines.en: {i}Oh, right. I’m supposed to slant myself here.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哦,对了。按规矩我该在这里自夸一番。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Hello! It’s me again. The one who isn’t the other one or the other one, but is still A one. Or THE one depending on how you want to prioritize stuff.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你好!又是我。既不是那个,也不是另一个的那个,但依然是『一个』。或者要看你怎么排优先级的话,是『唯一一个』。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Are you enjoying another trip to the beach? Because I know I am!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你又在享受又一次海滩之旅吗?因为我知道我很享受!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Though, I wouldn’t mind a break from the heat. Things have gotten out of hand lately but, despite how much I WANT to do something about it, I’m not sure if I CAN.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}虽说我也想躲开这暑气喘口气。最近事情有点失控,但尽管我『想』为此做点什么,我也不确定自己『能』做到。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Anyway, let’s see here...Oh, right!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}总之,让我看看……哦,对了!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Things have been kind of tough for you lately, huh?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你最近过得挺不容易的吧?{/i}

lines.en: {i}What with not really understanding why you’re suddenly so much more...well, let’s just say “aware” for lack of a better word.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}比如搞不懂自己为什么突然变得这么……好吧,找不到更好的词,就说『清醒』吧。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The things you once found interesting are starting to get a little dull, and so you’re now in search of something else to make you feel alive instead.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你曾经觉得有趣的东西开始变得有点无聊,所以你现在正在找别的东西,好让自己重新感觉活着。{/i}

lines.en: {i}This is totally normal! It happens to everyone.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这完全正常!每个人都会经历。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And while we all have our own unique ways of dealing with it, your situation is a little complicated since your life is kind of moving at hyper-speed right now to make up for lost time.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}虽然我们每个人都有自己独特的应对方式,但你的处境稍微复杂一些,因为你的人生现在正以超高速前进,好把失去的时间补回来。{/i}

lines.en: {i}So do what you always do and fasten your seatbelt as your bus could very quickly veer off a cliff if you’re not careful when steering it.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}所以,做你一贯会做的事就好:系好安全带,因为如果你不好好把握方向盘,你的巴士很可能一转眼就冲下悬崖。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Actually, in hindsight, I’m not sure how much help a seatbelt would be if you were to drive off a cliff...but still! Fasten it either way.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}话说回来,现在想想,真要是开车冲下悬崖,安全带到底能有多大作用我也不确定……不过还是要系!不管怎样都系上。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Because what I’m trying to tell you right now is that luring yourself into a false sense of security is the WORST thing you can do.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为我现在真正想告诉你的是:把自己哄进一种虚假的安全感里,是你能做的最糟的事。{/i}

lines.en: {i}When your days feel like they’re droning on and every morning is the same as always, it’s easy to sit back and think to yourself, “You know what? This isn’t so bad!”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}当日子过得像在原地嗡嗡打转,每个早晨都跟往常一模一样,你很容易就会往后一靠,心想:『你知道吗?这样也不算差嘛!』{/i}

lines.en: {i}But it’s that exact line of thinking that makes you the most vulnerable.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但恰恰是这种想法,会让你变得最脆弱。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Do you know who taught me that?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你知道是谁教会我这件事的吗?{/i}

lines.en: {i}It’s someone close to you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}是一个和你很亲近的人。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Someone who did that same exact thing and wound up paying the price for it.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一个做了完全相同的事,并为此付出代价的人。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Anyway, I just want you to know that you have to be careful.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}总之,我只想让你知道,你必须小心。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And even though you very likely can’t hear me right now and that things might not even change if you COULD, I wouldn’t be able to forgive myself if I didn’t tell you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}虽然你现在很可能听不见我说话,就算听得见事情也可能不会有任何改变,但如果不告诉你,我没办法原谅自己。{/i}

lines.en: {i}This could be your last summer.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这可能是你最后一个夏天。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But wouldn’t it be sad if it was someone else’s too?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可如果它同时也是别人的最后一个夏天,那不是很悲哀吗?{/i}

lines.en: {i}You know what? I’m gonna try my hand at another poem.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你知道吗?我打算再试着写一首诗。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It can be our little way of communicating with one another since every other method is a little...difficult right now.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}既然现在其他沟通方式都有点……困难,这就当成我们之间小小的交流方式吧。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Oh, and forgive me for using a cliche template to write it, but I’m still a novice when it comes to stuff like this.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哦,原谅我用了老套的模板来写,毕竟这种东西我还只是个新手。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Anyway, here goes nothing.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}总之,不管了,开始吧。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Roses are red, my eyes are blue.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}玫瑰是红的,我的眼睛是蓝的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The grass is all greenish, and you’re the real you!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}草儿绿油油的,而你是真正的你!{/i}

lines.en: {i}The real you is awesome! Just a little confused.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}真正的你超棒!只是有点迷茫。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But how could you not be when I’m confused too?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可我一样迷茫,你怎么可能不迷茫呢?{/i}

lines.en: {i}Done!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}写完了!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Kinda mid, huh?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有点中不溜秋,是吧?{/i}

lines.en: {i}I’ll get better. I promise.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我会进步的。我保证。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But until then, stay strong!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但在那之前,要坚强!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Like, really.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}真的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I’ve got a bad feeling about the end of this chapter.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}关于这一章的结尾,我有种不祥的预感。{/i}

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive1
: How’s that, my sweet? Is there any other...{i}area{/i} you’d like me to focus on?
lines.zh: : 怎么样,我的甜心?还有什么别的……{i}部位{/i}想让我多关照一下吗?

lines.en: : Perhaps one we may need to relocate somewhere {i}private{/i} for?
lines.zh: : 也许是需要我们换个{i}私密{/i}地方才能关照的那种?

lines.en: : No thank you, Nodoka. For the millionth time, this is plenty.
lines.zh: : 不用了,谢谢,Nodoka。我都说过一百万遍了,这样已经够了。

lines.en: : If you keep your eyes closed, you can pretend I’m anyone you want. Maybe even one of those handsome, rugged men from all those {i}naughty{/i} books you read?
lines.zh: : 只要你闭上眼睛,就可以把我当成任何你想的人。说不定是你读过的那些{i}下流{/i}小说里,某个英俊又粗犷的男人?

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive2
: Nodoka, I’m reading Watership Down right now. Which you should {i}know{/i} because you’re the one who lent it to me.
lines.zh: : Nodoka,我现在在读《Watership Down》。你该{i}知道{/i}才对,因为书就是你借给我的。

lines.en: : And which of the characters do you most see yourself mating with? I’ve always been rather partial to Hyzenthlay myself.
lines.zh: : 那你最想和里面的哪个角色交配呢?我自己一直挺偏爱 Hyzenthlay 的。

lines.en: : They’re rabbits...
lines.zh: : 它们是兔子……

lines.en: : Sorry, is that supposed to make some sort of difference?
lines.zh: : 抱歉,这有什么区别吗?

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive3
: Hah...forget it. I’m not attracted to animals and I am not attracted to you. And if that is going to be a problem, you can stop rubbing my shoulders.
lines.zh: : 哈……算了。我对动物没兴趣,对你也没兴趣。如果这有问题,你可以别再揉我的肩膀了。

lines.en: : Alas...the gap between our teacher and me grows stronger by the day. I’m getting rather jealous that he gets to have all the fun that {i}I’ve{/i} been forced to simply {i}dream{/i} of.
lines.zh: : 唉……老师和{i}我{/i}之间的差距正一天天拉大。他得以尽情享受那些我被迫只能在{i}梦里{/i}想想的乐趣,真是让我嫉妒。

lines.en: : If he would even call it fun. I can’t help but feel like I’ve been nothing but a disappointment in {i}that{/i} department as well.
lines.zh: : 如果他管那叫乐趣的话。我不禁觉得,在{i}那方面{/i}我也一直只是个让人失望的存在。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive4
: You know that’s not true.
lines.zh: : 你知道那不是真的。

lines.en: : You’re not a disappointment in {i}any{/i} area, Futaba. Anyone who thinks otherwise can not see the things I see.
lines.zh: : 你在{i}任何{/i}方面都不是让人失望的存在,Futaba。任何那样想的人,都看不见我所看见的东西。

lines.en: : Then I guess I just can’t “see the things you see.” Whatever that means.
lines.zh: : 那我大概就是没法『看见你所看见的东西』吧。不管那是什么意思。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive5
: What that means is, despite what you may think, the world is lucky to have such a pure, unblemished creature spending time on it.
lines.zh: : 那意思是,不管你怎么想,这个世界能有一个如此纯粹无瑕的生命在上面度过时光,是它的幸运。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t be able to call me pure anymore if you’d seen the things I’ve done with him.
lines.zh: : 要是你见过我和他做过的那些事,你就不会说我纯粹了。

lines.en: if futabalust15 == True:
scene beachwarsfive6
: Need I remind you that I {i}have{/i} seen the things you’ve done with him?
lines.zh: : 需要我提醒你,我{i}可是{/i}见过你和他做过的事吗?

lines.en: : You’ve seen one thing and it wasn’t even that big of a deal.
lines.zh: : 你只见过一件事,而且根本算不上什么大事。

lines.en: : I’d be happy to see more, you know.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意看更多啊,你知道的。

lines.en: : Not right now, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 现在不行,Nodoka。

lines.en: else:
scene beachwarsfive6
: Can I take that as an invitation?
lines.zh: : 我可以把这当成邀请吗?

lines.en: : Not right now, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 现在不行,Nodoka。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive5
: Hah...Futaba, spending this much time sulking is going to impact your chances in beating me tomorrow. Should you {i}not{/i} be focusing on that instead?
lines.zh: : 哈……Futaba,再这么闷闷不乐下去,会影响你明天打败我的几率哦。你{i}不是{/i}应该把心思放在那上面吗?

lines.en: : The fact that you’re spending your free time massaging me shows that you’re not that interested in giving it your all either.
lines.zh: : 你把自己的空闲时间都花在给我按摩上,这说明你也没那么想全力以赴。

lines.en: : The difference there is that I am simply unmotivated. You know better than most that I would be writing right now if my heart was truly in it.
lines.zh: : 区别在于,我只是没有干劲罢了。你比大多数人都清楚,如果真心想写,我这会儿早就动笔了。

lines.en: : Well, maybe...mine’s not in it either.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许……我也没那么想写。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive6
: And to think I believed your dive into the world of {i}true{/i} sexual activity would serve as inspiration for your stories. Yet here you are, the same as always.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你一头扎进{i}真正{/i}的性生活里,会给你的故事带来灵感呢。结果你还是老样子。

lines.en: : Things...don’t really feel any different, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 老实说……感觉并没有什么不同。

lines.en: : I’m glad I was able to move forward with Sensei, don’t get me wrong...but I still feel exactly the same as I always have and...
lines.zh: : 能和 Sensei 往前走一步我很高兴,别误会……可我感觉还是和从前一模一样,而且……

lines.en: : And I know I’m not the only one, so...
lines.zh: : 而且我知道我不是唯一一个,所以……

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive7
: You think he’s sleeping with someone else?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他在和别人上床?

lines.en: : I know he is.
lines.zh: : 我知道他是。

lines.en: : Any guesses as to who that may be? Anyone you’d like me to tear to shreds?
lines.zh: : 有没有什么猜测的人选?有谁想让我把她撕成碎片吗?

lines.en: : No thank you, Nodoka. I’ll...handle that in my own way.
lines.zh: : 不用了,谢谢,Nodoka。我会……用自己的方式处理。

lines.en: : Futaba, I love you. But right now, it seems like you’re incapable of handling pretty much anything.
lines.zh: : Futaba,我爱你。但现在看来,你几乎什么都处理不了。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive8
: Perhaps you should try being more like our {i}other{/i} sexually active friends? Just look at how well they get along when they’re not licking each other.
lines.zh: : 也许你该试着学学我们{i}其他{/i}那些有性生活的朋友?看看人家在不互相舔的时候,相处得多融洽。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive9
: Mnh...this is way harder than I thought it was going to be.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这比我预想的难多了。

lines.en: : I think what you have now is great. It doesn’t have to be, like...a million paragraphs long. Just speak from the heart and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你现在写的就很好。不用写它个……一百万段那么长。就发自内心地说就行。

lines.en: : If I speak from the heart, I’ll just wind up complaining about all the stupid shit he does and how he got to see your boobs before I did. And I doubt that will win me the competition.
lines.zh: : 我要是发自内心地说,到头来只会抱怨他干的一大堆蠢事,还有他怎么在我之前先看到了你的胸部。我怀疑那赢不了比赛。

lines.en: : Hey, who knows? Sensei likes when people are straight with him and he might actually be into you, like...spilling out that kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 嘿,谁知道呢?Sensei 喜欢别人跟他直来直去,他说不定还真吃这套——比如你把那些东西一股脑儿倒出来。

lines.en: : Mm...no. Some other time, sure. But I’m trying to approach this from a different angle this time.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不。改天吧,当然可以。但这次我想换个角度来写。

lines.en: : Then...maybe try playing up the friendship angle?
lines.zh: : 那……要不要试着打一下友情牌?

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive10
: Friendship angle?
lines.zh: : 友情牌?

lines.en: : Yeah. You don’t really worship him the same way everybody else seems to, and that makes it look like you guys are pretty close sometimes.
lines.zh: : 对啊。你不像其他人那样崇拜他,所以有时候看起来你们俩还挺亲近的。

lines.en: : I don’t think we’re particularly close.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得我们特别亲近。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive11
: Though, there was that one time I tackled him in the sketchy basement.
lines.zh: : 不过,是有那么一回,我在那个阴森的地下室里把他扑倒了。

lines.en: : Write about that then.
lines.zh: : 那就写那个。

lines.en: : No reaction at all to hearing that? Wack.
lines.zh: : 听到这个一点反应都没有?怪人。

lines.en: : I’ve watched enough anime to know that you probably just got scared of the dark and landed on top of him or something.
lines.zh: : 我看了那么多动画,用脚趾都能猜到,你大概是怕黑,然后就摔到他身上去了之类的。

lines.en: : You’re good.
lines.zh: : 你还真行。

lines.en: : I’ve had my share of cliche anime moments too. I’m pretty sure we’re all obligated to as Japanese school girls.
lines.zh: : 我也经历过不少动画里的老套桥段。我敢说,作为日本女高中生,我们都有义务经历一遍。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s the problem. I can’t approach this as a typical anime-style school girl because I’m always on the opposite end of things. People confess to {i}me. I{/i} am not people.
lines.zh: : 也许问题就在这。{i}我{/i}没法用典型动画女高中生的方式来写,因为{i}我{/i}总是处在事情的另一端。是别人向我告白。我不是会告白的人。

lines.en: : I am people. And I confessed to you. Maybe just let me write it?
lines.zh: : 我是会告白的人。而且我向你告白过。要不还是让我来写吧?

lines.en: : Well, what would you put in this middle part here? I feel like this is where I should open up about {i}why{/i} I allegedly like him, but I don’t think I know enough {i}about{/i} him yet.
lines.zh: : 那中间这一段你打算写什么?我觉得这里该敞开心扉,说说我{i}为什么{/i}喜欢他,可我觉得我{i}对他{/i}还了解得不够。

lines.en: : I have some ideas, but the last time I attempted to display my Sensei-based knowledge, we both got really mad and then I yelled out a bunch of stuff about you taking too long to finger me.
lines.zh: : 我倒是有几个想法,不过上次我试图展示我对 Sensei 的了解时,我们俩都气炸了,然后我还大吼了一堆关于你手指头磨蹭太久不给我弄的话。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I {i}do{/i} finger you now. So that probably won’t happen again.
lines.zh: : 是吗,可你现在{i}确实{/i}给我弄了啊。所以大概不会再发生那种事了。

lines.en: : Then maybe something like...
lines.zh: : 那也许可以写点像……

lines.en: : At first, I thought I was okay with just being friends.
lines.zh: : 一开始,我觉得只要做朋友就挺好的。

lines.en: : I haven’t spent much time around guys before, and I was always kind of worried I wouldn’t really fit in with them.
lines.zh: : 我以前没怎么和男生相处过,总有点担心自己融不进去。

lines.en: : But you always make me feel like I’m a little less of a fuck-up than I actually am. And being around you makes me comfortable in a way no one else ever has before.
lines.zh: : 可你总能让我觉得自己没那么废物。而且和你在一起时的那种安心,是别人从未给过我的。

lines.en: : You’re cool and mysterious...And you pay attention to me when I’m talking, even if what I’m talking {i}about{/i} doesn’t make any sense at all.
lines.zh: : 你又酷又神秘……而且我说什么你都会认真听,哪怕{i}我说的{/i}完全狗屁不通。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive12
: You’re there for me when things get bad, and you’re happy for me whenever they get good again. And sharing both of those moments is what makes what we have so special.
lines.zh: : 日子难过的时候你在,好转的时候你也为我高兴。而能与你分享这两种时刻,正是我们之间所以特别的原因。

lines.en: : Then, you could end with something like...I respect you a lot. And I’ve always admired you. But maybe that admiration is...a little more than {i}just{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 然后,你可以用类似这样的话结尾……我很尊敬你。也一直很仰慕你。但也许那份仰慕……{i}不止{/i}于此。

lines.en: : I want to know you better...in a million different ways.
lines.zh: : 我想更了解你……用一百万种不同的方式。

lines.en: : And I want you to know me too.
lines.zh: : 我也想让你了解我。

lines.en: : That was suspiciously good.
lines.zh: : 好得可疑啊。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive13
: Was it?
lines.zh: : 是吗?

lines.en: : {i}Very{/i} suspicious. Especially considering how nervous you were when you confessed to me.
lines.zh: : {i}非常{/i}可疑。尤其是想想你向我告白的时候有多紧张。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive14
: Maybe it’s...because I’m not actually confessing right now?
lines.zh: : 也许……是因为我现在并不是真的在告白?

lines.en: : Maybe. But it sounds more like this is something you’ve actually, like...put thought into.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但听起来更像是你真的、怎么说……认真想过的话。

lines.en: : Like it’s...something you were {i}going{/i} to say to him at some point.
lines.zh: : 像是……某个时候本来{i}打算{/i}对他说的话。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive15
: Hahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : No, that never even crossed my mind.
lines.zh: : 没有,我连想都没想过。

lines.en: : Rin, you can be honest with me. I know I’ve gotten all jealous and shit in the past, but I’m trying to, like...not be that way anymore.
lines.zh: : Rin,你可以对我说实话。我知道我以前嫉妒得要死,但我在努力……不再那样了。

lines.en: : If you used to like Sensei, just be honest about it. It’s not like finding out somebody has the hots for him is going to surprise me at this point when I already know he’s boning some of our friends.
lines.zh: : 如果你曾经喜欢过 Sensei,就直说吧。反正我早就知道他跟我们几个朋友有一腿,现在再听说有人对他有想法,一点也不意外。

lines.en: : Are you just going to stay silent?
lines.zh: : 你就打算一直沉默?

lines.en: : It’s embarrassing...
lines.zh: : 太丢人了……

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive16
: Why didn’t you ever tell him? Because of Chika?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么从来没告诉过他?因为 Chika?

lines.en: : It was...no. Maybe. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 那是……不。也许是。我不知道。

lines.en: : She might have had something to do with it. But it wasn’t until after all that happened that...I kind of...
lines.zh: : 她也许有那么点关系。但直到那一切发生之后,我才有点……

lines.en: : You kind of?
lines.zh: : 有点什么?

lines.en: : Kind of...brain.
lines.zh: : 有点……脑子坏了吧。

lines.en: : He’s just...so much older than me. It felt wrong. Or, like...I was just being stupid or something.
lines.zh: : 他就是……比我大那么多。感觉不对。或者说,像……我在犯傻之类的。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive17
: You do have a history of doing that.
lines.zh: : 你确实有干这种事的前科。

lines.en: : I’m well aware, Otoha. Thank you for reminding me.
lines.zh: : 我很清楚,Otoha。多谢提醒。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive18
: I don’t think the age thing is that big of a deal, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得年龄这事没那么要紧。

lines.en: : What? Weren’t you, like...
lines.zh: : 什么?你不是之前……

lines.en: : Didn’t you have the exact opposite opinion of that before?
lines.zh: : 你以前不是完全相反的看法吗?

lines.en: : I could have sworn you thought it was super creepy that Sensei’s into, like...you know. {i}Us.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我发誓你以前觉得 Sensei 对{i}我们{/i}、你知道的,『这个』,超恶心。

lines.en: : It is. What I meant is, more specifically, I don’t think it’s weird for girls our age to have crushes on older people.
lines.zh: : 是挺恶心的。我的意思是更具体一点:我不觉得我们这个年纪的女生对年长的人心动有什么奇怪。

lines.en: : We can’t help but look up to and admire the adults we’re around all the time. So if one of us starts developing feelings for one of those adults, it’s not like...weird, right? It’s normal.
lines.zh: : 我们整天围在身边的成年人,自然会仰望、会仰慕。所以如果有人对其中某个成年人产生感情,那不……奇怪对吧?很正常。

lines.en: : I mean...I’m obviously not one to talk. And I see where you’re coming from. It just feels like this isn’t how you used to-
lines.zh: : 那个……我显然没什么资格说别人。我也明白你的意思。只是感觉这不像你以前的——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Whatever. Could you give me that speech again?
lines.zh: : 行行行。随你。你能把刚才那段话再说一遍吗?

lines.en: : I think I’m gonna steal some of it after all.
lines.zh: : 我决定还是偷用几句。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive19
: Nee-chan, what are you doing? Why are you here and why did I have to leave all of my friends just to come welcome you?
lines.zh: : Nee-chan,你在干什么?你为什么在这儿,又为什么非得让我丢下所有朋友来接你?

lines.en: : Do you {i}not{/i} care about your big sister anymore? Shouldn’t you {i}want{/i} to welcome me?
lines.zh: : 你不在乎你姐姐了吗?你难道{i}不该{/i}{i}想{/i}来迎接我吗?

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be {i}working?{/i} And {i}not{/i} hanging out on a beach with a bunch of girls who worship you?
lines.zh: : 你不是该去{i}工作{/i}吗?而{i}不是{/i}和一群崇拜你的女生在海滩上鬼混?

lines.en: : Do you have any idea what sort of chaos would break out if your presence here was known by literally anyone {i}other{/i} than me?
lines.zh: : 你知道除了我{i}以外{/i},只要有任何人发现你在这里,会闹出多大的乱子吗?

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive20
: Of course. Why else do you think I made you come get me? I need your help getting to the inn without being detected.
lines.zh: : 当然知道。不然你以为我为什么叫你来接我?我需要你帮忙,让我不被发现地混进旅馆。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive21
: Oh, which one of us doesn’t care about the other {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦,那{i}现在{/i}我们俩是谁不在乎谁?

lines.en: : I’m allowed to use you for my own personal gain. I was born first.
lines.zh: : 我当然可以利用你来为我自己谋利。我先生出来的。

lines.en: : Yeah. {i}Way{/i} first. Go be a dinosaur somewhere else and stop chasing after your youth. It is gone and never coming back no matter how many miles you run each day.
lines.zh: : 是啊,早生{i}好多{/i}年。去别的地方当恐龙吧,别再追你逝去的青春了。它已经走了,而且不管你每天跑多少英里都不会回来。

lines.en: : Speaking of my exercise regimen, where’s Akira? He and I have {i}business.{/i}
lines.zh: : 说到我的运动计划,Akira 在哪儿?我和他有{i}生意{/i}要谈。

lines.en: : {i}Business?...{/i}
scene beachwarsfive22
: That’s right, baby sister. I’m here on an important {i}business{/i} trip. To conduct {i}business.{/i}
lines.zh: : 没错,小妹妹。我是来出重要{i}差旅{/i}的。来做{i}生意{/i}。

lines.en: : Nothing more. Nothing less.
lines.zh: : 不多。也不少。

lines.en: : I really hope I don’t become this pompous when I lose {i}my{/i} virginity.
lines.zh: : 我真希望{i}我{/i}破处以后不要变得这么拿腔拿调。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive23
: Boop.
: This is hardly the time for booping! Go home!
lines.zh: : 现在可不是啵的时候!给我回家!

lines.en: : Sure. Right after I finish my {i}business transaction.{/i}
lines.zh: : 好啊。等我办完这桩{i}生意交易{/i}就走。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive24
: Stop calling it that! It’s weird!
lines.zh: : 别再这么叫了!太怪了!

lines.en: : I can’t. You might be recording me.
lines.zh: : 我做不到。你可能在录音。

lines.en: : You’re my sister!
lines.zh: : 你是我姐姐!

lines.en: : Exactly. Which means you might be trying to steal my time in the spotlight. Royal families used to kill each other all the time for the crown, you know.
lines.zh: : 没错。正因如此,你可能会想抢走我的聚光灯。皇室家族可是会为了王位互相残杀的,你知道吧。

lines.en: : Nee-chan! Akira is busy this weekend! He doesn’t have time for {i}business!{/i}
lines.zh: : Nee-chan! Akira 这个周末很忙!他没时间做{i}生意{/i}!

lines.en: : Oh, he’ll {i}make{/i} time for me. It’s a {i}very{/i} important transaction.
lines.zh: : 哦,他会为我{i}挤出{/i}时间的。这可是一笔{i}非常{/i}重要的交易。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive25
: Brag some more, why don’t you?...
lines.zh: : 再吹点牛呗,嗯?……

lines.en: : Tsk tsk, baby sister. If only you were older and more attractive. Maybe {i}then{/i} you’d have a chance at stealing my boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 啧啧,小妹妹。你要是再大一点、再漂亮一点就好了。{i}那样{/i}你说不定还有机会抢走我的男朋友。

lines.en: : Careful, Nee-chan. I could be {i}recording.{/i}
lines.zh: : 小心点,Nee-chan。我可能在{i}录音{/i}哦。

lines.en: : And by “boyfriend,” I meant “business partner.” Thank you, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 而我说的『男朋友』是指『生意伙伴』。谢谢你,Noriko。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Could you take your finger off of my nose now? I can’t breathe.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。你能把手指从我鼻子上挪开吗?我喘不过气了。

lines.en: : As soon as you take me to Akira. I’m sure he’s eagerly awaiting my arrival as we speak.
lines.zh: : 等你带我去见 Akira 再说。我相信他此刻正迫不及待地等着我的到来。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive26
: Any last words, Arakawa?
lines.zh: : 还有什么遗言吗,Arakawa?

lines.en: : Yes — thank you.
lines.zh: : 有——谢谢。

lines.en: : For what?
lines.zh: : 谢什么?

lines.en: : This.
lines.zh: : 这个。

lines.en: : You’re pathetic.
lines.zh: : 你可悲。

lines.en: : Can you shift your right leg a bit? I can only {i}kind of{/i} peek up your skirt and I’d like the last thing I ever see to be a tiny bit closer to actual nudity.
lines.zh: : 你能把右腿挪一挪吗?我现在只能{i}勉强{/i}从裙子里瞄到一点,我希望我这辈子最后看到的东西,能稍微更接近真正的裸体一点。

lines.en: : Okay, you guys. That’s enough pretend-homicide for the day. Wakana, why not come on down from the bed and-
lines.zh: : 好了各位。今天的假装杀人就到这儿吧。Wakana,你先从床上下来,然后-

lines.en: : And completely disregard the sanctity of truth or dare? What kind of a fool do you take me for?
lines.zh: : 然后彻底无视真心话大冒险的神圣性?你把我看成什么傻瓜了?

lines.en: : I am here to kill a pervert and I will not leave this inn until Arakawa is six feet beneath the soil.
lines.zh: : 我是来杀一个变态的,在 Arakawa 被埋进六尺黄土之前,我不会离开这家旅馆。

lines.en: : Is this really that big of a deal? It’s just a poem, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 这真有那么严重吗?只是一首诗而已,Wakana。

lines.en: : No. “The Road Not Taken” is {i}just a poem.{/i} This is a betrayal.
lines.zh: : 不。《未选择的路》才{i}只是一首诗{/i}。这是背叛。

lines.en: : I was nice to you for almost {i}three hours{/i} under the pretense that you would participate in this competition. Do you have any idea how mentally taxing being {i}nice{/i} to you is?
lines.zh: : 我假惺惺地对你好,就因为你会参加这场比赛,差不多整整{i}三个小时{/i}。你知道对你{i}和颜悦色{/i}有多消耗精神吗?

lines.en: : Did I give you permission to speak?
lines.zh: : 我允许你说话了吗?

lines.en: : You asked me a question.
lines.zh: : 你刚刚问了我一个问题。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive27
: It was rhetorical, Arakawa!
lines.zh: : 那是反问,Arakawa!

lines.en: : Senseeeeei, are you in here? I need help with-
lines.zh: : Senseeeeei,你在里面吗?我需要帮忙-

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive28
: Woah! Forget whatever I came in here for! I want to sleep in {i}this{/i} room now!
lines.zh: : 哇哦!我进来要干嘛来着?管它呢!我现在想睡在{i}这个{/i}房间!

lines.en: : This isn’t really the best time, Kirin. Could you go be horny somewhere else? I’m trying to prevent a murder.
lines.zh: : 现在真的不太方便,Kirin。你能去别的地方发情吗?我正在阻止一场谋杀。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive29
: And walk away from this?! No way!
lines.zh: : 然后就这么走掉?!想都别想!

lines.en: : Also, you’re just standing there! If anything, you're an accessory to murder!
lines.zh: : 而且你就那么站着!要说的话,你也是谋杀的共犯!

lines.en: : I am a lover, not a fighter.
lines.zh: : 我是爱人,不是战士。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} am a fighter. And I will now kill this man for slighting me — as well as anyone {i}else{/i} who bears witness to my crime.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}是战士。我现在就要杀了这个男人,因为他侮辱了我-顺便连同{i}任何{/i}目睹我罪行的人一起。

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive30
: But if you kill {i}him{/i} who else will teach me how to fish?!
lines.zh: : 可你要是杀了{i}他{/i},还有谁来教我钓鱼啊?!

lines.en: : Is that why you’re here? Why would you just assume that I know how to fish?
lines.zh: : 你就是为这个来的?你凭什么想当然地觉得我会钓鱼?

lines.en: scene beachwarsfive31
: Should I have assumed you’d be getting a footjob from Miss Watabe instead?! Because while that does seem slightly more probable, it’s still out of left field!
lines.zh: : 那我该想当然地以为你会被 Watabe 老师用脚伺候吗?!虽然那个稍微更有可能一点,但一样是莫名其妙!

lines.en: : Man, I tried to warn you things would get out of control once Wakana showed up, Senpai. But nooooo. Screw apologies and screw poetry. Let’s just get stepped on instead.
lines.zh: : 天哪,Senpai,我早就警告过你 Wakana 一出场事情就会失控。可你偏不,不不不。道歉和诗歌都去死吧,我们干脆被人踩好了。

lines.en: : I regret nothing.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不后悔。

lines.en: : Me next!
lines.zh: : 下一个是我!

lines.en: scene black
: Everyone, shut up! You’re giving me a headache!
lines.zh: : 所有人,闭嘴!你们吵得我头疼!

lines.en: {i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}
